Intel: detect diagnostics in malformed Python code

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"diagnostics\":true,\"language\":\"python\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def broken(\n    return\nclass", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.diagnostics());
    }
}
```
